task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Use the left arm to lift the handy blue stapler with metal parts and set it on the lightweight black rectangular displaystand
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高稳定性，不变形，进入框架使用左臂举起带有金属部件的便捷蓝色订书机，并将其放置在轻巧的黑色矩形展示架上
